question:
Select the option that can substitute the underlined word segment with the most appropriate idiom.

26 January 1950 is a __memorable__ day for the countrymen.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **"red letter".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• **Memorable : (यादगार)** - Worth remembering or easily remembered, especially because of being special.
